scope: Read-only terminal CI input inventory; no workflow/settings changes

dry_run.description: Dry run only (list candidates without deleting)

max_age_days.description: Minimum age in days before a branch is eligible

steps.name: Configure dry-run flag
steps.run:
# Scheduled runs are always dry-run during the rollout window.
# Manual dispatches honor the input.
if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "schedule" ]]; then
  echo "dry_run=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "max_age_days=30" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "dry_run=${INPUT_DRY_RUN:-true}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo "max_age_days=${INPUT_MAX_AGE_DAYS:-30}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Identify candidate branches
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
git fetch origin --prune --quiet

# Cutoff in seconds-since-epoch.
cutoff=$(($(date +%s) - MAX_AGE_DAYS * 86400))
patterns='^(dependabot|copilot|feature)/.+$'

candidates=()
while IFS=$'\t' read -r ref committerdate; do
  branch="${ref#refs/remotes/origin/}"
  # Skip protected names defensively, even though the regex above
  # already excludes them.
  case "$branch" in
    main|master|develop|HEAD) continue ;;
    release/*|hotfix/*) continue ;;
  esac
  if ! [[ "$branch" =~ $patterns ]]; then
    continue
  fi
  if [[ "$committerdate" -ge "$cutoff" ]]; then
    continue
  fi

  # Must be already merged into origin/main.
  if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "origin/$branch" origin/main; then
    continue
  fi

  # Skip if the tip commit message contains 'WIP:' (escape hatch).
  tip_msg=$(git log -1 --format=%B "origin/$branch" || true)
  if printf '%s' "$tip_msg" | grep -q 'WIP:'; then
    continue
  fi

  candidates+=("$branch")
done < <(git for-each-ref --format='%(refname)\t%(committerdate:unix)' refs/remotes/origin/)

{
  echo "## Branch cleanup candidates"
  echo ""
  echo "- dry_run: ${{ steps.config.outputs.dry_run }}"
  echo "- max_age_days: $MAX_AGE_DAYS"
  echo "- candidate count: ${#candidates[@]}"
  echo ""
  if [[ ${#candidates[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "_No candidates._"
  else
    echo "| Branch | Last commit |"
    echo "|--------|-------------|"
    for b in "${candidates[@]}"; do
      d=$(git log -1 --format=%ci "origin/$b")
      echo "| \`$b\` | $d |"
    done
  fi
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

# Persist the list for the delete step.
printf '%s\n' "${candidates[@]}" > /tmp/branch-cleanup-candidates.txt
echo "count=${#candidates[@]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Delete branches (skipped on dry_run)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
while IFS= read -r branch; do
  [[ -z "$branch" ]] && continue
  echo "Deleting origin/$branch"
  git push origin --delete "$branch"
done < /tmp/branch-cleanup-candidates.txt

steps.name: Diff committed vs regenerated
steps.run:
if ! git diff --exit-code docs/index.md; then
  echo ""
  echo "docs/index.md is out of sync with src/."
  echo "Run \`npm run catalog\` and commit the regenerated file."
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Safety-surface SSOT drift gate (perm tiers + egress denylist + secret paths)
Check TypeScript coverage threshold
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
summary=coverage/coverage-summary.json
if [ ! -f "$summary" ]; then
  echo "Missing $summary -- the test job must emit the json-summary reporter."
  exit 1
fi
lines=$(jq -r '.total.lines.pct' "$summary")
branches=$(jq -r '.total.branches.pct' "$summary")
functions=$(jq -r '.total.functions.pct' "$summary")
printf 'TS line coverage:     %s%%\n' "$lines"
printf 'TS branch coverage:   %s%%\n' "$branches"
printf 'TS function coverage: %s%%\n' "$functions"
awk -v v="$lines"     'BEGIN { exit (v + 0 < 80) }' || { echo "TS line coverage $lines% is below the 80% threshold"; exit 1; }
awk -v v="$branches"  'BEGIN { exit (v + 0 < 75) }' || { echo "TS branch coverage $branches% is below the 75% threshold"; exit 1; }
awk -v v="$functions" 'BEGIN { exit (v + 0 < 80) }' || { echo "TS function coverage $functions% is below the 80% threshold"; exit 1; }
echo "TS coverage gates: OK"

steps.name: Audit each runtime requirement set
steps.run:
set -u
status=0
# Unfixable upstream advisories go here with a dated reason, so one
# of them cannot hold every merge hostage. Empty today.
IGNORE_VULNS=""
IGNORE_ARGS=""
for vuln in $IGNORE_VULNS; do
  IGNORE_ARGS="$IGNORE_ARGS --ignore-vuln $vuln"
done
for set_name in audio diffusion ocr; do
  req="runtimes/${set_name}/requirements.txt"
  if [ ! -f "$req" ]; then
    echo "::error file=${req}::runtime requirement set is missing"
    status=1
    continue
  fi
  echo "::group::pip-audit ${req}"
  if ! python -m pip_audit -r "$req" --progress-spinner off                  ${IGNORE_ARGS}                  --format json --output "audit-${set_name}.json"; then
    echo "::error file=${req}::pip-audit reported advisories for ${set_name}"
    status=1
  fi
  python - "$set_name" <<'PYCOUNT'
import json, sys
name = sys.argv[1]
with open(f"audit-{name}.json", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    report = json.load(fh)
deps = report.get("dependencies", [])
flagged = [d for d in deps if d.get("vulns")]
print(f"{name}: {len(deps)} packages audited, {len(flagged)} with advisories")
for dep in flagged:
    ids = ", ".join(v.get("id", "?") for v in dep["vulns"])
    print(f"  - {dep['name']} {dep.get('version')}: {ids}")
PYCOUNT
  echo "::endgroup::"
done
exit "$status"

steps.name: Allowlist job results
steps.run:
set -uo pipefail
fail=0
for var in $(env | sed -n 's/^\(R_[A-Za-z0-9_]*\)=.*/\1/p' | sort); do
  eval "result=\${${var}-}"
  case "${result}" in
    success|skipped) ;;
    *) echo "FAIL: ${var#R_}=${result:-<empty>}"; fail=1 ;;
  esac
done
exit "$fail"

steps.name: Run diff-cover on changed lines
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [ ! -f coverage/lcov.info ]; then
  echo "::error::coverage/lcov.info missing -- vitest must emit the lcov reporter"
  exit 1
fi
diff-cover coverage/lcov.info \
  --compare-branch=origin/main \
  --fail-under=80 \
  --markdown-report=diff-coverage.md \
  --html-report=diff-coverage.html

steps.name: Comment diff-cover report on PR (on failure only)
steps.run:
if [ -f diff-coverage.md ]; then
  gh pr comment "$PR_NUMBER" --body-file diff-coverage.md
else
  gh pr comment "$PR_NUMBER" --body "diff-cover failed but no markdown report was produced. Check the workflow logs."
fi

steps.name: Fail job when diff-cover failed
steps.run:
echo "::error::Changed-lines coverage is below 80% (see diff-coverage.md artifact and PR comment)"
exit 1

steps.name: Build non-release installer rehearsal (PyInstaller onefile + DMG)
Sign + notarize (best-effort)
steps.run:
set -e
DMG_PATH="dist/NexusSetup.dmg"
if [ -z "$APPLE_DEVELOPER_ID" ]; then
  echo "::warning::APPLE_DEVELOPER_ID not configured -- skipping codesign + notarization (unsigned DMG; see the download page caveats)"
  exit 0
fi
# Sign the staged onefile payload (bundle or bare binary), then
# notarize + staple the shipped DMG directly.
STAGE="scripts/installer/build/stage"
PAYLOAD="$STAGE/Nexus AI Studio Setup.app"
[ -d "$PAYLOAD" ] || PAYLOAD="$STAGE/Nexus AI Studio Setup"
codesign --force --deep --options runtime --sign "$APPLE_DEVELOPER_ID" "$PAYLOAD" || true
KEYFILE="$RUNNER_TEMP/AuthKey.p8"
echo "$APPLE_NOTARY_KEY_B64" | base64 -d > "$KEYFILE"
xcrun notarytool submit --wait \
  --key "$KEYFILE" \
  --key-id "$APPLE_NOTARY_KEY_ID" \
  --issuer "$APPLE_NOTARY_ISSUER_ID" \
  "$DMG_PATH" || true
xcrun stapler staple "$DMG_PATH" || true

  case "${result}" in
    # v2.11.0 Phase 6.5 (CI-v251-1): no leg skips by design, so a

steps.name: Match package version, tag, and checked-out commit
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")
EXPECTED_TAG="v${VERSION}"
if [ "$RELEASE_TAG" != "$EXPECTED_TAG" ]; then
  echo "Release tag $RELEASE_TAG does not match package version $EXPECTED_TAG" >&2
  exit 1
fi
git fetch --force --tags origin
TAG_SHA=$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}^{commit}")
CURRENT_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
if [ "$TAG_SHA" != "$CURRENT_SHA" ] || [ "$TAG_SHA" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ]; then
  echo "Release tag $RELEASE_TAG does not resolve to the checked-out workflow commit" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo "version=$VERSION" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "tag_name=$RELEASE_TAG" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Extract release notes from CHANGELOG
Revalidate annotated tag immediately before publication
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
REMOTE_TAGS=$(git ls-remote --tags origin "refs/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}" "refs/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}^{}")
TAG_SHA=$(printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_TAGS" | awk '$2 ~ /\^\{\}$/ {print $1; exit}')
if [ -z "$TAG_SHA" ]; then
  TAG_SHA=$(printf '%s\n' "$REMOTE_TAGS" | awk -v tag="refs/tags/${RELEASE_TAG}" '$2 == tag {print $1; exit}')
fi
if [ -z "$TAG_SHA" ]; then
  echo "Annotated release tag ${RELEASE_TAG} is missing or has no peeled commit on origin" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$TAG_SHA" != "$EXPECTED_SHA" ]; then
  echo "Release tag ${RELEASE_TAG} moved during the workflow: expected ${EXPECTED_SHA}, found ${TAG_SHA}" >&2
  exit 1
fi

fields: 23 workflow files define GitHub Actions jobs.
package.json has fast/full/platform script names, but no report/release and no complete five-profile contract.
Agree and prove five bounded profiles that reuse existing validators, with list/JSON/report outputs.
All 23 retained workflow inventories have zero profile calls; validation lists remain inline.
Replace inline lists with proven profile calls incrementally.
ci.yml excludes only dependabot pushes; installer-tests/sandbox also accept feature pushes.
Remove ordinary feature-push validation after preserving integration-PR coverage.
No complete full/platform profile calls; shell Windows/macOS are absent on integration PR.
Run full and required platform groups on the merge result and include their verdicts in the gate.
ci/shell run suites on both PR and protected-branch push; codeql/secrets also repeat.
Separate PR validation from minimal post-merge smoke/provenance.
Protected-branch pushes run root and desktop suites.
release.yml reruns source validation; semantic-release publishes on main push; no release profile.
Reconcile release ownership, packaging/provenance/dry-run profile, and approved publication triggers.
ci-required and installer-required are unconditional allowlists; only ci-required is protected and it omits shell/installer aggregates.
Preserve the stable context while incorporating intended platform verdicts; separately approve settings changes.
Fresh main/develop protection requires only ci-required.
ci.yml has no paths filter; unrequired shell and other workflows still use workflow path filters. No fresh excluded-path PR exercise.
Move relevant detection to fail-closed job scoping and observe required-context resolution.
All parsed jobs are hosted or reuse local hosted workflows; no self-hosted jobs.
shell-build selects three OS hosts only on main or dispatch; Windows init skips PR. Installer matrix does cover three OS legs on PR.
Move required shell/Windows legs to integration PR with reviewed job-level scoping.
All external uses references are 40-character SHA pins with comments; reusable workflow references are local.
Separate pending cache-version updates do not invalidate pin immutability.
Eleven workflows have jobs with implicit inherited permissions.
Review explicit read defaults and necessary job writes; each permission change requires approval.
Manifest-keyed cache inputs exist; complete cold-install exclusion and cache-content qualification are not proven.
Inventory cache consumers and qualify exact proposed changes.
CI/shell/installer matrix cancel superseded validation; release and semantic-release do not cancel. Other groups are not fully qualified.
Reconcile all validation groups and retain non-cancelling release boundaries.
No self-hosted jobs or pull_request_target; reusable installer jobs inherit secrets. No fresh fork qualification.
Review each secret/write-capable reusable leg and prove untrusted PR behavior.
Native coverage/SARIF subsets exist, but no common summary/JUnit/SARIF index/environment metadata contract across profiles.
Produce summary and valid partial metadata on failure, reusing runner outputs.
Shell coverage upload is Ubuntu-only after success and has no retention-days. Other retention periods vary.
Publish required failure evidence unconditionally with reviewed explicit retention.
Tag/dispatch identity checks exist; main-push semantic release has no enforced PR-review/admin boundary. Exact validated-artifact publication is not fully proven.
Reconcile release ownership and separately decide protection over validated artifacts.
New living runbook requires local reproduction, affected-gate rerun, environment investigation and release holds.
Fresh protection/ruleset responses are retained and documented; no automatic mutation.
Strengthening is a separate concrete approval.
